name: @colloq/shared
//: Not a workspace and nothing installs from it. This file exists for one reason: to mark these .ts files as ESM. Without it Node treats them as CommonJS (the root has no "type"), so shared/notebook.ts loads yjs.cjs while an ESM caller loads yjs.mjs — two Yjs instances, and every instanceof check between them fails with 'Unexpected content type in insert operation'. The bundlers already treat this directory as ESM; this only tells the loaders that run it unbundled.
